title: Choose the portfolio's direction
question: The safer hand: two familiar portfolio forms, plus the Awwwards standard. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Four Posters
options.thesis: Each project is a full-height poster in one series; the poster you point at opens.
options.viewport: Your name across the top, then four colour posters edge to edge, the first one open on a SkolarTrack screenshot.
options.risk: Expanding colour panels are a familiar Awwwards pattern, so the type has to carry it.

options.label: Four Works
options.lineage: white-cube gallery hangs and wall labels
options.thesis: The projects hang as framed works on a gallery wall, each with a museum label.
options.viewport: Wall text with your name on the left; SkolarTrack framed on the right with its label, the next work peeking in.
options.risk: Quiet by design and dependent on strong screenshots, which two of the four projects do not have yet.

canonCard.label: The Awwwards standard
canonCard.lineage: set against jesperlandberg.com and twks.ch, Sites of the Day in the past two weeks
canonCard.thesis: The monochrome, type-led portfolio that wins Site of the Day, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: A project index in large type, a preview image following the cursor, and your full name across the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Looks like many other portfolios by design.
